title: Mystic Tiles
description: A turn-based roguelike tile-reveal explorer. Navigate a 10x10 enchanted forest grid, dodge ancient traps, and reach the hidden portal.
detailedDescription: An enchanted forest materializes as a 10x10 grid of hidden tiles. Every step reveals what lies beneath â€” safe paths, ancient traps (spikes, poison ivy, crumbling ground), glowing wisdom crystals, and the elusive portal that advances you to the next level. Turn-based movement means every decision counts: plan your route, memorize revealed tiles, and manage risk. Between expeditions, spend wisdom crystals on permanent boons: extra health, trap detection, crystal magnetism, and portal sense. Permadeath makes every expedition tense and meaningful.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move one tile at a time. Revealed tiles show their contents. Reach the portal to advance. Spend crystals between runs on permanent upgrades.
